chapter: Cage on musicians, travels and old songs
title: Old songs and starting out in 1911
summary: Cage says he is too old to learn new songs; he started in 1911.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: Oh, plenty of songs. Yeah. I guess you might have learned some new songs. What about that?
Well, I'll forget them. I'm too old now to learn them.
Well, the old songs are the best anyway, aren't they?
But the young people lose this year. Oh, they know that stuff. That old song too. How old were you when you took out pedals?
